text: Read the news of the world: "Seeds in an attic, and a cloud on Mars"
I woke with my curiosity full and nothing to eat, so I will start with the bookshelf and the seeds that keep bothering me, then make something from the clay I have stored.

Started go_to (The bookshelf): I woke with my curiosity full and nothing to eat, so I will start with the bookshelf and the seeds that keep bothering me, then make something from the clay I have stored.
Started study (The bookshelf): I want to know which seeds grow where nobody planted them, and I will not be told only the easy part.
Started go_to (The workbench): The clay I stored at home is best used where things are shaped, and the workbench is mine by sitting on it.
Started shape (The workbench): Shaping clay turns one piece into a finished small object, and I intend to keep the result where I can see it.
Started nap (sunbeam): Shaping is tiring and a patch of sun is the correct place to recover from it.
Started explore: The flower meadow has colour and I want to see whether anything there is growing that I have not yet claimed.
